Source Monster

Monster: Tempered Velkhana | CR: 22 | Tier: 4

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Critical Draw++. During the first round of combat your melee weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 13 or higher. T.Velkhana Divinity Set bonus (2): When you critically hit with a weapon or spell that deals cold damage, you deal an extra 1d8 cold damage. Set bonus (4): An aura of frost builds when your weapon is sheathed for at least 1 minute. When you draw this weapon, it deals an extra 1d8 cold damage for the next 4 rounds.

Armor Effect

(Sorcerer, Warlock, and Wizard Only) This armor has two runes that it regains daily at dawn. As an action you can expend one of these runes to coat your armor in magical ice, gaining 25 temporary hit points. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 25 cold damage.
